tools.name: find_company
tools.description: Use this when you need to identify a public company on 6ix by ticker or name before asking for its news releases or events. Returns matching companies with ticker, exchange and their 6ix page.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a specific company announced, or wants its latest or past news releases. Returns releases newest first with dates and 6ix.com links; call get_news_release for a release's full text.

tools.name: search_news_releases
tools.description: Use this when the user wants releases about a topic, person, deal, project or result across all companies, for example drill results, financings, acquisitions or a named executive. Searches the full text of every release on 6ix and returns matches with a short excerpt. Put quotes around an exact phr

tools.name: get_news_release
tools.description: Use this to read the complete text of one news release, given the id or 6ix.com link that another 6ix tool returned.

tools.name: latest_news_releases
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what companies have announced today or recently across the market, optionally on one exchange such as TSXV, CSE, TSX, NASDAQ or NYSE.

tools.name: get_company_events
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a company's earnings calls, webinars or investor presentations, upcoming or past, including replays on 6ix.

tools.name: earnings_calendar
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which companies hold earnings calls in a date range, for example this week, optionally on one exchange. Dates are UTC.
